note: Generic industry profile, NOT a specific researched business -- unlike Nick's Plumbing & Air Conditioning, no named clinic was researched here. All facts below are industry-wide statistics gathered during the original candidate-business research pass (2026-08-13), before Nick's Plumbing was selected as the full-build demo business.

facts.fact: Dental practices face missed calls and difficulty getting appointments, driven by staffing shortages and high patient volume.
Poor scheduling is one of the most considerable inefficiencies in dental practices -- many still use systems that produce double bookings and underutilized time slots.
If the practice's phone line is busy (e.g. staff doing insurance checks) when a patient calls, the practice will likely lose that potential patient.
More than 93% of patients who rated their satisfaction highest said communication with the practice was easy.

pain_points.description: Busy phone lines and inefficient scheduling systems lose potential patients and create double-booking/underutilization, industry-wide.
pain_points.evidence: Industry-wide statistics above are verified; whether they apply to any specific unnamed clinic is an inference by design, since no specific clinic was researched for this seeded profile.

automation_opportunities.opportunity: AI-assisted scheduling/call overflow handling: when the phone line is busy or after hours, an AI step captures the patient's request and offers available slots or a callback, instead of the call simply going unanswered.
automation_opportunities.rationale: Directly targets the verified 'busy line loses the patient' gap and the double-booking/underutilization pattern, using the same AI-draft-plus-human-oversight structure already proven for Nick's Plumbing.
